title: Add Direct Idea response
description: The reply of fleetd. When outcome is accepted it carries the new idea and its feature; when refused it carries the reason (orchestrator, D15). A retry with the same idempotency_key returns this reply again.

outcome.description: Closed list from connect response_payload: accepted, or refused with its reason (orchestrator, D15).

reason.description: Why fleetd refused the request, e.g. a stale assumptions hash, a wrong state, or a caller inside a fleet attempt. Present only when outcome is refused.

feature_id.description: The feature of the idea: the one named with --to, or the new one fleetd created.
